title: Sign Up Checkbox Causes Infinite Loop Error
description: Clicking the 'bring it with you' checkbox during sign up causes 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error in Radix UI Checkbox component.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Find Radix Checkbox usage in signup form
Identify state update causing infinite loop
Fix: Remove circular state dependency in checkbox
Checkbox can be clicked without console errors
Checkbox state toggles properly when clicked
Sign up process completes successfully with checkbox checked
Sign up process completes successfully with checkbox unchecked

notes:
Error details:
- Error: 'Maximum update depth exceeded'
- Location: @radix-ui_react-checkbox, checkbox.tsx:20
- Component: SignupPage

Reproduction steps:
1. Navigate to /signup
2. Click the 'bring it with you' checkbox
3. Observe console error: 'Maximum update depth exceeded'

Root cause: Likely a circular state update - checkbox onChange triggers state change that re-renders checkbox with new checked prop, which triggers another onChange, creating infinite loop.

Common fixes:
1. Use onCheckedChange instead of onChange
2. Ensure controlled component doesn't update state inside render
3. Check if value is being set in both controlled and uncontrolled mode
